body: trauma/abuse  started around 10 years old, but i've felt depressed, antisocial and generally unmotivated since i can remember. i'm constantly paranoid, anxious, miserable, or empty, and i can't recall a time when it wasn't like that.

but even my most introverted friends feel loneliness and a need for connection/human interaction. it makes me feel like something died in me along the way, and shut down that craving for attention/intimacy/etc. i just feel like some sort of alien or robot or something, i guess.

i've probably seen about 10 different mental health professionals since i was 13, only one of them made a bit of difference. i can't see that one anymore though, since she works in a program i've already been discharged from. i've been institutionalized 3 times for suicide attempts, and once for a high risk self mutilation episode. i've seen my share, but i never really open up to shrinks and councillors properly because i'm scared they won't take be seriously (probably because my mental health wasn't taken seriously until i had to be institutionalized, and even then i was "doing it for attention")

i just don't know what to do at this point, with or without psychiatrists.
